payload.title: Structured human interaction contracts
payload.description:
Purpose: Let host applications attach stable action identity, typed resource references, freshness preconditions, expiry, and structured response schemas to Tactus human interactions without coupling the runtime to any host product.

Exclusions:
- Host authorization and persistence.
- External notification delivery.
- Product-specific resource routing.

Definition of Done:
- Existing Human primitives accept and preserve the optional generic metadata.
- Structured review responses are validated deterministically.
- Replay and callback behavior remain compatible.
- Outside-in specifications and quality gates pass.
